description: Validates that context_ratio is calculated correctly as impulseTokens / totalInputTokens

impulsesLoaded.description: Array of impulse IDs that were loaded

impulsesCreated.description: Array of newly created impulse IDs (may be empty)

contextRatio.description: Ratio of impulse tokens to total input tokens (50/200 = 0.25)

tokens.description: Token breakdown with input, output, and cache fields

validationRules: contextRatio = 0.25 when 50 impulse tokens and 200 total input tokens
tokens must be an object with input, output, and cache fields
